purpose: Mechanism I: third confirmatory test of TEMPORAL_ANCHOR_AT_CONTEXT, narrowly scoped to the TEMPORAL_BOUNDARY sub-regime only (Ledger Entries A/B). Campaign V2's third candidate, selected from AAMR-internal accumulated evidence rather than the external discovery pool.
excludes_note: all 63 units used or examined anywhere in this arena to date (55 pre-Mechanism-H + 6 second-hop-expansion-v1 fresh units already counted in that 55 + 6 hyde-query-reformulation-v1 fresh units + their own _abs variants by base id). Exact list embedded in the freeze script's own excluded set at build time.

inputs_used: question text (task shape only, fixed regex classifier)
selection_rule.classifier: is_temporal_boundary() in scripts/arena/temporal_anchor_at_context.py -- question_type in {temporal-reasoning, multi-session} AND question text matches a duration/arithmetic pattern ("how many/long ... days/weeks/months ..." + a two-event relation word: since/between/after/before/had passed/did it take/took/from-to). Structurally excludes filter/count-many-item shapes (Ledger Entry B's known negative-transfer trap: 00ca467f, a many-item count question with a diverging session-vs-event-date anchor) by construction -- every matched question asks for one duration value between at most two named events.
selection_rule.method: fixed classifier applied to all fresh (post-exclusion) LongMemEval-S candidates before any individual inspection; deduped by base id (drops _abs siblings of an already-matched base); stable question_id-ascending sort; first 8 taken.
selection_rule.why_8_not_6: this is a confirmatory replication of an already-twice-tested mechanism (E1 exploratory positive; Stage 2 fresh replication net-negative overall but 2/2 clean positive specifically within this narrower sub-regime) rather than a first exploratory test of a brand-new candidate -- matches RAW_PROVENANCE's own successful 8-unit fresh-replication scale that elevated it to REPLICATED_VALIDATED_TRANSPLANT.

regime_rationale: TEMPORAL_BOUNDARY (duration/arithmetic between two named events) is the one sub-regime where TEMPORAL_ANCHOR_AT_CONTEXT has shown a clean signal in every AAMR sample it has appeared in to date: E1 (qualitative, gpt4_f420262c-style ordering), and cleanly in Stage 2 (08f4fc43, 0bc8ad92 -- 2/2 flips wrong-to-correct, 0 regressions). All 3 of Stage 2's regressions occurred outside this bucket (2 in TEMPORAL_POSITIVE, 1 in NON_TEMPORAL_CONTROL via the diverging-anchor trap this classifier structurally avoids).
